primary_meaning: God (and specifically Christ) as firm foundation, strength, refuge, and source of salvation/security

alternatives.meaning: Peter (or the Petrine office) as the foundation of the Church
Peter’s confession of faith (or the content of that confession) as the foundation
Christ (or the gospel) as a rock of stumbling / offense to the unbelieving
Believers themselves as living stones built on the Rock/Christ

notes: Across OT and NT the dominant, near-universal Christian usage treats 'rock' as a divine title and metaphor for God’s/Christ’s reliability and protective strength. The only significant ongoing dispute concerns the precise referent of the 'rock' in Matthew 16:18; that local controversy does not overturn the broader symbolic consensus.
